notes: Signed off with conditions (.mob/records/297/signoff-ctx6.md). Criteria: 1 a blocked Codex shell fails the command probe naming shell path, sandbox mode and 1920; 2 a working shell passes with path and mode recorded, and a Codex driver is placed only on a fresh command probe under the invocation's sandbox mode, with no bypass flag; 3 voting, navigating and read-only seats are still placed when only the command probe fails (red 1 63180c2, green 1 ebf22e8; reds 6c10f91 and ecd4fb8, greens f951bde and 1a90fa6; reds 7b08dee, e3d6a45 and a092d9f, greens 668ec09 and 2caf7bd). Limits stated in the sign-off: check 2's lock and commit-on-main half rests on card 230's tests, and no test runs a Codex driver through probe, placement, command and commit together; the machine fix is not applied, so Codex build seats stay refused on this PC until the product owner approves a non-Store PowerShell or Codex set to use cmd; shell_path pwsh.exe in core/backends.json is a placeholder; the legacy non-card turn path is not command-gated; the probe nonce also appears in the prompt text; the card's setup-notes part is not implemented. Done check 2 reads: commits on main in the one checkout under the single-writer lock. Follow-up bug cards are filed for the legacy path and the nonce. Deviations: the sign-off seat was killed by a reboot and re-run; F-085 was breached on 8 of 14 seat starts (66 to 145 minutes); the pre-ship gate reported a wrong HEAD (corrected in its record); the retro pick had one vote round and no independent re-run.
